Windows x64

RELEASE CANDIDATE

Windows 10 / 11 · Python included

  1. Install the official Microsoft C++ x64 runtime.
  2. Download and extract the entire ZIP.
  3. Run Event-Based-Studio.exe and keep _internal beside it.

Release notesSHA-256 checksumsThird-party information

Downloads are assembled from hosted parts and verified with SHA-256 in your browser. No account or app-data upload is required by the desktop application.

Your recordings stay local.

The desktop app has no telemetry, account, or cloud-upload service. Projects live in your user storage folder. You choose what to export and share.

Read privacy information ↗

Start with CSV.

CSV, DAT and H5/HDF5 event recordings open through bundled readers, including ECF compression. File import needs no WSL or OpenEB. Live cameras require a separate Metavision SDK and driver.
